change_history.ai_topic: Basel III Capital Adequacy Reporting (BCAR) template changes
change_history.ai_summary: Restructured Land ADC reporting lines in schedules 10.030 and 10.060, replacing SA/IRB split with Residential/Commercial split; modified credit conversion factor notation for off-balance sheet commitments in schedule 10.050; removed 'New'/'never used' annotations from risk weight lines in schedules 40.040 and 40.050; corrected cell reference typo.

Release of Version 4.1 of the BCAR Technical Specifications - Data Definitions, updating the Cover Sheet version and date, adding new exposure classes and risk weights (e.g., 861, 862, 863, 864), modifying risk weight criteria (e.g., equity at risk >=25% instead of >25%, purpose-built rental), and updating schedule codes (e.g., 139 to 139c).
Removal of data fields 5630, 5631, and 5720 from BCAR reporting schema; schema location reference updated from BA.xsd to (Cleaned) BA.xsd
